# How Advantage Personal Training Grew 395% with WellnessLiving

![How Advantage Personal Training Grew 395% with Family-Friendly Scheduling and a Focus on Strength for Life](https://www.wellnessliving.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/APT-Blog-Cover-1024x683.webp)

Last Updated on 24 February, 2026

> “Our members’ wins are our wins. That’s what drives me—to help people feel strong enough to live fully.” – Brian Sipotz, Advantage Personal Training

## Customer Overview

- **Business Name:** [Advantage Personal Training](https://advantagestrength.com/)
- **Location:** Ann Arbor, Michigan
- **Owner:** Brian Sipotz, CEO
- **Services:** Small group personal training for adults, youth athletic development, team training
- **Clients Served:** Primarily adults aged 45–65 and youth athletes aged 10–19

* * *

When former professional hockey player Brian Sipotz was offered a chance to start a training program in Ann Arbor, he jumped in with coaching instincts, an exercise science degree, and a passion for movement. What began as a youth sports program has grown into a thriving, two-floor facility serving families across generations.

> “Whether it’s a kid making a team or a 70-year-old client hiking without hesitation, we’re here to help people stay strong for life.”

But as his business evolved, Brian’s old software couldn’t keep up with his growing needs. Scheduling was clunky. Parent-child accounts were disconnected. And customer support wasn’t responsive. That’s when he switched from Mindbody to [**WellnessLiving’s all-in-one wellness business management software**.](https://www.wellnessliving.com/home.html)

Since making the switch nine years ago, Brian has grown Advantage Personal Training 395%, simplified operations, and empowered his team to deliver an exceptional client experience—without the tech headaches.

![Clients at Advantage Personal Training, having a huddle before a match. ](https://www.wellnessliving.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Pic-4-600x352.jpg)

* * *

## The Business: Strength Training for All Ages

Advantage Personal Training offers two distinct yet interconnected programs under one roof:

- **Youth sports performance** (ages 7–15): focused on athletic development and long-term confidence
- **Adult functional training** (ages 45–65): designed to promote lifelong strength and mobility

Their model serves the whole family, often at the same time—but in different dedicated spaces.

> “They walk in the front door together. The kids branch off upstairs, and the adult comes down for their session. They both walk out in an hour having gotten exactly what they needed.”

![Advantage Personal Training studio's student's going through an obstacle course. ](https://www.wellnessliving.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/pic-1-600x399.jpg)

* * *

## The Challenge: Outgrowing a One-Size-Fits-All System

Like many independent gym owners, Brian started with Mindbody. But it quickly became clear that the software wasn’t built for his growing needs.

#### Key pain points:

- No way to link parent and child accounts, making scheduling and billing confusing
- Inconsistent customer support with long wait times
- Rising costs that didn’t reflect added value
- A lack of tools to manage cyclical revenue and client retention

> “I tried explaining our model, and it just didn’t compute. It made things really tough.”

Manual workarounds added time and complexity—taking Brian away from strategy and growth.

* * *

## The Solution

Brian switched to **[WellnessLiving’s fitness studio software](https://www.wellnessliving.com/fitness/software/)**—and found a system that matched his business model. With key features designed for family account management and streamlined operations, the switch unlocked capacity and confidence for his entire team.

#### With WellnessLiving, Brian was able to:

- Link parent and child accounts, simplifying youth program registration and billing
- Use a one-click family toggle, making it easy for parents to manage their child’s schedule
- [Automatically celebrate client milestones](https://www.wellnessliving.com/features/manage-clients/) with session badge alerts
- Streamline staff clock-ins and payroll with the built-in time tracking tool
- Access [custom reports for trends, retention risk](https://www.wellnessliving.com/features/isaac/), and top-performing offers

> “It runs our payments, it tracks our sessions—I don’t have to think about that anymore. That freed me up to grow.”

* * *

## The Results: Smarter Tools, Sustainable Growth

Since adopting WellnessLiving, Advantage Personal Training has:

- Grown 395% over nine years
- Maintained year-over-year growth, including a 1% increase during COVID
- Created a predictable, diversified revenue stream across youth and adult programs
- Cut down admin time across membership management, scheduling, and payroll
- Trained staff to own daily operations with clear, easy-to-learn tools

> “We’ve grown every single year we’ve been in business—nine of those with WellnessLiving.”

* * *

## Favorite Features

- **Parent-Child Account Linking**

Simplifies family scheduling and billing by pinning child accounts to the parent profile.
- **Milestone Badges**

Automatically highlight client achievements at check-in, making it easy for staff to celebrate and retain clients.
- **[Staff App & Time Clock](https://www.wellnessliving.com/features/elevate-page/)**

Allows seamless clock-ins from mobile or desktop, improving onboarding and time tracking.
- **[Reports Dashboard](https://www.wellnessliving.com/features/advanced-reporting/)**

Provides visibility into expiring memberships, top-performing offers, and payroll—without needing external spreadsheets.
- **[Customer Support](https://www.wellnessliving.com/features/caasi/)**

Responsive, knowledgeable support that helps Brian’s team solve issues fast.

> “Now I get someone on the phone right away who knows the software. That’s a big deal.”

* * *

## WellnessLiving is Built for Family-Focused Fitness Businesses

> “What I love about WellnessLiving is that for a business like mine—working with both parents and kids—it makes things logical and easy. That leads to a bigger business for us.”

Today, Advantage Personal Training is a community-driven, multi-generational fitness business that continues to grow—because the systems behind it make that growth possible. For Brian, WellnessLiving isn’t just a tool. It’s a partner in his mission to make strength training accessible for everyone.

> “WellnessLiving is constantly improving. That’s what makes me want to stay with them—and why I’d recommend it to anyone who’s serious about scaling their business.”

* * *

## ❓ Personal Training Growth Case Study: FAQs ❓

**How did Advantage Personal Training achieve rapid revenue growth?**

Advantage Personal Training grew revenue by improving scheduling flexibility and making services more family-friendly. By removing barriers to attendance and offering strength-focused programs, they increased client engagement and created a more consistent revenue stream.

**Why is family-friendly scheduling important for personal training success?**

[Flexible scheduling helps clients fit training into busy lives.](https://www.wellnessliving.com/features/online-booking/) When parents and working adults can easily book around school, work, and family commitments, they are more likely to commit long-term. This reduces churn and increases repeat bookings.

**How did a focus on “strength for life” impact client retention?**

A strength-for-life mindset shifted clients’ goals from short-term fixes to long-term wellness. When clients see measurable progress over time, they feel more invested. This deeper engagement encourages continued membership and increases lifetime value.

**What operational changes supported the studio’s growth?**

Clear scheduling protocols, staff alignment, and [consistent coaching standards](https://www.wellnessliving.com/features/elevate-page/) helped minimize friction. The business also leveraged metrics to understand attendance and retention patterns. These operational improvements created capacity for more training without burnout.

**What should other studios learn from this case study?**

Prioritize accessibility and client outcomes. Make it easy for clients to attend regularly and define clear, meaningful goals for them. Combining operational efficiency with client-centered programming supports sustainable growth, not just short-term spikes.
